Politics · India

Parliament Monsoon Session Begins Amid Opposition Protests and Disruptions

India's Parliament monsoon session commenced with disruptions and opposition uproar. Left-leaning outlets reported the suspension of TMC MP Kalyan Banerjee from the Lok Sabha for the remainder of the session. Centrist coverage highlighted repeated adjournments on the opening day, with some noting the Prime Minister's address and the NEET row. Right-leaning coverage focused on Prime Minister Modi's call for a productive session and his praise for a young space team, while also mentioning opposition protests over a NEET paper leak and alleged theft related to the Ram Temple donation.
